subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared inbound attachment metadata contract for channel plugins, and what fields and privacy rules should be stable for agents?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes the channel-to-agent context contract and privacy boundary; automation should not choose that API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design shared metadata
options.body: Add a cross-channel attachment metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper while preserving current media fields.

options.title: Use Slack-only stopgap
options.body: Expose only Slack file metadata now, accepting likely drift or a later migration when other channels need the same shape.

options.title: Keep current workflow
options.body: Declare placeholders, MediaPath fields, and Slack download-file guidance as the supported contract and close the structured metadata request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Design shared metadata
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel attachment metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper while preserving current media fields.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on the shared inbound context builder and plugin SDK surface where a cross-channel contract would likely land.
